description: This source file implements SOAP message building functions for CCSP CWMP protocol, including methods for constructing various SOAP requests such as GetRPCMethods, Inform, TransferComplete, Kicked, RequestDownload, AutonomousTransferComplete, among others. It uses XML DOM manipulations to assemble the SOAP envelopes and body contents dynamically based on input parameters.

methods.name: char * CcspCwmpSoappoBuildSoapReq_GetRpcMethods(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * pRequestID)
methods.description: Builds a SOAP request message for the 'GetRPCMethods' operation, constructing the XML envelope with the appropriate namespace and method name.

methods.description: Builds a SOAP request message for the 'Inform' operation, including device info, event list, time, and parameter values, assembled into an XML SOAP envelope.

methods.description: Builds a SOAP message for the 'TransferComplete' method, including fault information, start and complete times.

methods.description: Constructs a SOAP message for the 'Kicked' notification, including command, referer, argument, and next URL details.
